o5_gain.current_o5_scope: T2500310-v2 distinguishes O5a/b/c; terminal A+ sensitivity is not guaranteed at O5 start

ringdown_basis.snr_window: About 10M after strain peak, amplitude/phase fits and SNR integration consistent (Bhagwat section II). Upper time endpoint not explicitly established in this read scope.
ringdown_basis.window_mass_convention: Do not silently equate paper symbol M to local final-mass tM convention; exact conversion not certified here
ringdown_basis.applicability: Berti order100/year at RD>=50 is configuration/population dependent. Multi-mode Fisher forecast, not delta_tau220 identifiability or 5-sigma evidence.
ringdown_basis.uncertainty: Quoted errors belong to source simulation; not a new confidence interval on astrophysical rate
